title: Rivals of Ixalan Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A conqueror known as the Butcher of Magan who advises cutting the beasts out from under the enemy.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A figure who commands stillness in flavor text.

entities.name: Itzama the Crested
entities.description: A speaker who tells of Kinjalli sculpting humans from clay and dinosaurs from stone.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: A sun deity said to have sculpted humans from clay and the dinosaurs from unyielding stone.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who advises a foe not to struggle.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who urges squabbling pirates to seek gold instead of trinkets.

entities.name: Yacha
entities.description: An Otepec huntmaster who armors ferocidons and lets them loose.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A speaker who declares that fools have done it.

entities.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
entities.description: A figure whose centuries-long search is ended.

entities.name: Hadana
entities.description: A figure who seeks power in the service of peace.

entities.name: Mavren
entities.description: A figure who sought a savior and found what he sought.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker whose memory shards slide into place on seeing the great sphinx's chamber.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact over which a struggle for control darkened the world beneath a blood-red sky.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A realm that bends nature, including dinosaurs, to its will.

entities.name: Grim Captain
entities.description: A figure whose lure of undeath a gravestone is made to silence.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: A group of which Yacha is a huntmaster.

events.summary: The struggle for control of the Immortal Sun plunges the world into darkness under a blood-red sky.
events.quote: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

events.summary: Jace sees the great sphinx's chamber and his memories begin to return.
events.quote: As soon as Jace laid eyes on the great sphinx's chamber, the shards of memory began sliding into place.

events.summary: Vona and Mavren each find what they sought, a conqueror and a savior.
events.quote: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .
